2026-10-13.headline: Update 10-13-2026
notes: Fixed an issue where attempting to save Barbarian face customizations would fail.

Each boss in a raid with a lockout timer is now a checkpoint and once killed. Any spawn point tied to this boss's timer will not spawn when you resume the raid. While this is not particularly useful in today's content, this will be useful in later content.
The replay timer requirement for joining a group member's raid has also been removed. However, you will not receive loot from bosses if you have already killed that boss today.
Widened Perceptions now works correctly after you switch to a low-level loadout.
Unbound Cascade now adds to your base critical damage. Before this fix, it actually lowered your crit damage.
Pets with equipped items now use new and improved damage and delay calculations. When picking a pet weapon, its ratio now matters much more than its base damage.
Player pet damage no longer applies weapon damage bonus to items that no longer exist.
Increased the level cap for upgraded player pets from player level - 1 to player level.
The Kobold-slaying achievement now names the continent of Odus instead of Gloomingdeep.
Magical Monologue no longer appears in the Bard song list.

2026-09-09.headline: UPDATE 09/09/2026 [1 of 1]
downtime: Servers will come down at 6:00 AM PDT, estimated duration 3 hours.
notes: Non-Respawning Zones are now known as Dungeon Crawls!
Dungeon Crawls are active in indoor Dungeons. They function similarly to the old Non-Respawning Zones, but with special rewards for clearing the Dungeon Crawl.
To finish, slay every rare creature and enough of the zone's original population. Nothing you kill will respawn naturally.
You'll earn motes and experience upon completion, and anything you killed may add its loot and coin to the Bonus Chest on completion.
The easier the zone is for you, the smaller the payout.
Finish the Dungeon Crawl, and you get your instance charge back.
Rare creatures will appear on your map while in a Dungeon Crawl.
Spell Casting Subtlety, Symphonic Aura, and Reaching Notes are now toggleable without the rank of the AA changing.
The 'Disabled' Ranks of AAs have been removed, and 'Enabled' removed from the names of the AAs.
Fixed a bug where Blood Rune's cap was 5/8/10 instead of 5%/8%/10% of player's maximum HP.
Symphonic Aura now suppresses spell instrument animations and sounds.
The "You're Faunny!" and "It's Plane to See" achievements should now be properly labeled as optional.
Fixed the running animation acting strange when using instruments or attacking.
Bosses in the Plane of Sky are now all flagged as rare creatures.
Fixed an issue that made pets not able to proc AOE spells.
The levitation fall rate has been normalized for smoother falling experiences.
Spider Silk Cap can now once again be upgraded.
Further prevented detrimental spells from stripping beneficial spells when their effects collide.
Fixed an erroneous string when attempting to leave an instance while in combat.
Added a message about the failure to earn an instance recharge if a dungeon crawl is too easy.
The non-existent zone line from Mistmoore Castle to The Bloodfalls no longer appears in the Find window.
The "Quick Buff" Alternate Ability Timer will now reset upon player death.
Weapon Procs that normally work with the AA 'Symphonic Aura' will no longer be prevented from firing while Symphonic Aura is active.
Symphonic Aura spell sounds should now be silenced while grouped, not just while solo.
The AA "Master of All" is now one rank, with a cost of 10 AAs. The one rank allows you to increase all of your specialization skills beyond the limit.
"I'm Boared", "Herbicide" and "Living Stone, I presume?" are now marked as optional achievements for completing the meta achievement "Highly Decorated."
Guild Halls, Housing, and Special Events are now marked as optional achievements for completing the meta achievement "Norrathian Explorer".
The description of the spell effect of Greater Potion of Antibody (Aura of Antibody) now reports that it increases Charisma as well as Disease Resistance.
Player pets now respect lore equipped restrictions when transferring items from the player pet inventory.
Fixed an issue where group members while charmed or feared may not receive loot.
Spell upgrade suffixes will now also appear correctly in chat for status updates such as interrupts, fizzles, missed notes, wore-off, and damage.
The Magician AA Ability Turn Summoned should no longer show unobtainable ranks.
Maps have been added for the Plane of Hate, The Hole, Rathe Mountains, and Runnyeye.
Falling damage and knockback effects are no longer affected by the game's performance on your machine.
Knockbacks are now capped on damage for pressure based on the distance that could actually have been traveled, and falls are now capped at a reasonably high amount of damage.

The formula for strategy skill was modified, and the endurance reduction curve is now less rough. Endurance costs are much lower at lower levels compared to before, and they are slightly lower by level 50.
Modified Offensive, Ranged and Striker Stance endurance costs. They now use the endurance costs before all item upgrades.
Added accuracy bonuses to upgraded weapons. This is additive with Stance Bonuses. Both melee and ranged weapons gain additional accuracy bonus.
Backstab damage on items now scales with weapon upgrades.
Added a new AA, Widened Perception, that increases the amount of loadouts available to your character by 1.
A new toggleable AA called 'Point Blank Fire' has been added for Rangers, Rogues, Monks and Berserkers.
The Weapon Mastery of the Scout AA has had it's damage percentages lowered to 20/40/60%.
Ranged Stance has been revamped. Ranged Stance will now parallel Offensive Stance:
Cancel magic will now dispel detrimental buffs on allies and beneficial buffs on hostiles.
If a hostile cast (PC/pet on NPC or NPC on PC/pet), then only strip beneficial buffs
If a friendly cast (PC/pet on PC/pet ), then only strip detrimental buffs.
If NPC on NPC or any information can't be found, use legacy strip first buff logic.
The spells Alter Plane: Hate and Alter Plane: Sky now benefit from the reagent cost reduction granted by spell ranks. At rank 10, it is not required for the player to possess the reagent at all.
Heart Harpies in the Plane of Sky will proc their AoE mesmerization much less frequently.
Swapping Loadouts with an item equipped that is not Keyring Compatible (ie; stackables like Fishing Grubs) will now send the item into the Inventory.
The achievement "Drawing Life from a Stone" is now marked as optional for the achievement Highly Decorated.
Hand of the Maestro will no longer spawn in non-raid Plane of Hate.
The following NPCs are no longer required for
Ambassador D`Vinn
Retlon Brenclog
Boondin Babbinsbort
Ssynthi
Corrupter of Life
Linara Parlone
Brother Hayle
Brother Gruff*
Auraline

2026-09-01.headline: UPDATE 09/01/2026 [1 of 2]
notes: Players can now receive bonus quest loot drops in the Plane of Sky for the classes in their current loadout. The drops will go into your Personal Loot pool and are affected by your loot filters such as auto-store and auto-destroy.

These bonus drops extend to all enemies that drop items used in Plane of Sky class quests except for the lettered "Wind Rune" items. That means main bosses, Efreeti, and even regular enemies that are needed for specific drops like many of the enemies on Islands 6 and 7.

The bonus drops are not guaranteed but there are separate chances for all of the classes in your loadout - meaning that on occasion you can have three additional items added to your personal loot for a single kill!
You can now change your gender as part of configuring a loadout.
Your currently selected face and eyes now save and can be stored as part of Loadouts.
Levitation spells have had their descent rate adjusted to be consistent when slowly floating down.
Kerran now count for the "Not a Kerran the World!" Achievement.
Various Achievements are now marked optional that are not completable in the current expansion.
The achievements relating to zones Freeport Sewers, Jaggedpine Forest, Caverns of Exile, and Nedaria's Landing are no longer active as they are inaccessible.
The achievement Hunter of Toxxulia Forest is no longer active as it no longer has any valid targets.
Full Potential will now autogrant at level 50. If you previously did not receive this AA, swap to any level 50 Loadout and zone.
The Valiant Steed and Abyssal Steed AA abilities have been removed and the points refunded to all players who had these abilities.
Fixed an issue where 3 NPCs in North Ro were flagged as named, despite the fact that they are obviously just Troopers.
Malloy the Songbird in West Freeport no longer is tagged as a rare creature.
Clockwork XIVB in Akanon should no longer show up as a humanoid.
Enchanted Fine Steel Morning Star is now usable by Beastlords
Added a missing ornamentation socket to Ancient Spurned Waistcoat.
The various Brooch rewards from the Rathe Mountains Froglok quest lines no longer have a level requirement.

Dispel spells are treated as detrimental for targeting in Spellblade procs.
Fixed an issue where some checkboxes and labels were word wrapping too soon when using fractional scaling.
Right clicking on the spell gem in the actions window will now operate the same as right clicking else where in the list. Added an upgrade hint to the description section.
Added a toggle to smooth out camera motion while in first person mode.
Fixed an issue where an improper message would appear when trying to leave an instance in combat.

NPCs with secondary melee classes will now be able to use those class combat skills like bash, kick, cleave, frenzy, backstab, and monk kicks.
Fixed an issue where your target was not cached when you start a cast, causing spells to land on the current target.
Overseer Rael should now properly spawn in The Arena
Chesgard Sydwen should no longer direct you to himself when asking him about the Bloodsabers.
The Estate of Unrest has seen fit to keep some its doors locked, meaning that adventurers should plan to go find the keys they need to navigate the estate.
Tranixx Darkpaw will no longer terrorize the zonelines of Blackburrow.
Zok Zribb, in the Froglok encampment in the Rathe Mountains, has a new quest.
Master Yael should no longer flee at low health.
Added ladder to open grave, and gates across the false exit in Tutorial.
The Muglwump will now actually spawn in a reasonable amount of time from instance creation.
Mignar Mi' Draskch in Neriak Commons now sells the Wizard Spells master list.
Puntar Sandfisher's corpse should no longer stand up and start creating pets. The body should also no longer be considerable.
In Instance Voidlings can now See Invisible players.
Lewis Reldnok's message for new Gnomish Paladins should be less confusing now.
The voidlings that create raid instances should no longer appear inside of personal instances.
Fixed a bug causing group EXP to not be calculated correctly in some scenarios
Implemented changes to raid targets to better scale with group size
All Motes of Potential are no longer tradable.
Drakkin no longer appears as an option when using a Race Unlock Token.
Added Disrupting Shot, a new Discipline/Combat Ability for Rangers.
Added Tendon Slice, a new Discipline/Combat Ability for Berserkers.
Added Skull Bash, a new Discipline/Combat Ability for Berserkers.
Players should no longer forage up out of era items in the Tutorial, or the New Sebilisian Expedition.
Fix tier 1 upgraded summon item spells so they properly create +1 items.
The spell upgrade boost to summoned item tiers now applies to items summoned within a container, such as Summon: Phantom Plate.
Spell upgrades now boost damage to bard AoE songs, such as Denon's Disruptive Discord.
Upgraded pets will now remain upgraded across zonelines.
Upgraded pets will now cast spells at their upgraded level.
Spell upgrades will now increase the level cap efficiency for pacify, fear, & stun spells.
The Ranger spells Firefist, Nature's Precision, and Force of Nature will no longer try to overwrite the lower level spells in the book as you attempt to scribe them.
Fixed an issue impacting resist interactions with OverChannel Invocation.
Re-enabled OverChannel resistance bonuses for buff-based resistance checks
Empower now applies to bard AoE songs, such as Denon's Disruptive Discord.
Updated Actions Window macros (socials) tab to a scrollable list instead of paged buttons.
Stance/Invocation bar hidden context menu should now sync properly allowing you to unhide stances and invocations.
Fix merging to equipment items and allow merging to activated items inventory (including from loot window).
Spell upgrades: Motes to-be-consumed will now appear with a red border in the inventory (similar to item merging).
Ethernere Tainted Karana will no longer show up in the find window in the Western Plains of Karana.
Renamed the "Augmentation" Tab to "Exaltation" on the Storage tab for default / default_light / default_modern.
Kerran is now available as a player character race. Kerran primary race unlocks are achievable by exploring Kerra Isle.
The Troopers have removed the barricades in the New Sebilisian Expedition, allowing for adventurers to venture forth, and discover what lies beyond, and maybe figure out just what this place is....
Introducing Void-touched Potential, a new token that can be earned up to 3 times per week from raid activities through voidlings.
Void-Touched Potential can be merged like motes to increase an item or spell's rank by +1.
Auto attack will no longer persist if your target's death causes their owned pet to subsequentially despawn.
Fixed NPC spell casting logic so that it respects spell reuse and recovery times and prioritizes damage over harmful spells.

Stunned players now receive a short-term immunity from additional stuns that lasts beyond the duration of the current stun. This will prevent chain stunning. However players beware, NPCs also learned the basics of this skill.
Loss of player control spells (such as NPC charm) are now capped to 30 seconds duration.
Improved casting behavior of multi-class bards to better prevent stuck-states between songs and casting spells.
Added the Unbound Alacrity AA, a new autogranted class AA for Monk
Added the Unbound Life AA, a new autogranted class AA for Paladin
Added the Unbound Ferocity AA, a new autogranted class AA for Beastlord
Added the Unbound Versatility AA, a new autogranted class AA for Bard
Added the Unbound Drain AA, a new autogranted class AA for Shadow Knight
Added the Unbound Lethality AA, a new autogranted class AA for Rogue
Added the Tricksters Misdirection AA, a new class AA for Enchanters.
Ranks 9 and 10 of Harm Touch will now add a Damage Over Time effect to their target.
The Leech Touch AA is now a passive ability.
Flesh To Bone will now create NODROP Bone Chips, that can still be used for summoning spells.
Activating skills Cleave or Frenzy will reduce the cooldown time of the Rampage AA
The Improved Bash AA can now utilize the best item (weapon or shield) from the primary, secondary, or Any slots.
Quickbuff now excludes lull / pacify spells.
Alternate Ability Timers should no longer have collisions, such as Cannibalize triggering Harm Touch or vice-versa.
Frogloks now use Classic appropriate sounds!
Removed placeholders from and lowered maximum respawn times in several dungeons:
Rare monsters in Crushbone flagged as rare monsters
Crushbone's Orc Scoutsman and Orc Warden respawn timers substantially reduced
Chokehold in Crushbone is now susceptible to melee attacks.
Reduced the kicking vigor of low level NPC monks.
Players will no longer receive motes while at the class lock cap. [You can't stay at level 10.999 forever!]
Motes will no longer drop for players unless they were eligible to gain exp from the kill.
All races are now eligible to equip items, such as for charm pets.
One of the bees in Plane of Sky should no longer become a murder bee upon being charmed.
Guild Masters should no longer point new characters towards NPC that don't exist, to complete quests that don't exist.
All methods of quitting an instance will now also cause you to leave that zone.
Killing a raid boss while you have a loot lockout will now give one guaranteed drop from that boss’s unique treasure tables, along with possible drops from its standard loot pool.
Shield of the Immaculate now requires being equipped to use the activated effect, and has a 6 second recast time.
Headsplitter Axe no longer sillily usable by Monks, Rogues, or Beastlords.
Slave Trammels now properly reflect being leg irons.
Spiky Splintmail now has a worn graphic and its clicky has been shifted to Bramblecoat
Ornamentation slots added to new model-visible items from Crushbone
Several Crushbone items have received worn graphics.
Rib-bone Stiletto graphics have been updated.
Improved Beastlord Warder mana regeneration values.
Pets can now be summoned with a permanent illusion using illusion items in activated item storage.
Upgraded pet spell level base damage bonus now applies to some pet skill attacks and will more reliably increase base melee damage.
The Shaman spells Tortoises Healing, Slugs Healing, and Snails Healing are now all tied to the correct spell scroll.
Familiars will no longer show pet statistics.
Disabled the remaining throwable Concoctions made by Alchemy.

UI Scaling and text filtering have been added to options window. Text filtering can change the way text appears on screen making it sharper or a little more blurry depending on the setting you prefer. Scaling options are 1, 2, 3 ,4 ,5
Updated the Help options in game to remove incorrect information and remove the out of date tips.
Tinted the pet inventory slot border red if you have an active pet and the item is not equip-able due to class or level.
Windows size is no longer saved if the window is in the minimized state allowing you to restore properly on next game open.
Auto Add Hater Targets has been changed to Auto Add Hate Targets.
Buff charge counters should be properly displayed (e.g., "17" will be displayed instead of "1").
Original Kerra Isle music should play more frequently.
Original Plane of Sky music should play more frequently.
Loot drops will correspond to the difficulty tier you’re in, plus a diminishing chance to roll higher tiers. For example, in D1, you will roll +1 or higher. * In D4, you will roll +4 or higher.
Implemented improved backend stability for instances.
Fixed an issue that was causing instances to close prematurely.
Fixed an issue where changing loadout to Kerran for the first time resulted in no textures being displayed.
Fixed an issue that prevented Armor Ornamentations from being inserted into certain item types, such as chain arms on monk arms, or robes on chestplates.
Updated the grave marker for Aradune in East Karana.
Fixed an issue preventing autoinventory from working in certain circumstances.
Using Harm Touch IX will no longer unintentionally damage the player.
The Full Potential AA should now remain effective after swapping to a loadout that is not level 50.
The inhabitants of Kerra Isle will now consider players slaying Erudites favorably. They will also celebrate in the slaying of local kobolds in the Warrens.
Shanis MacDarren should no longer tell new Barbarian Berserkers to talk to Haladorf.
Fixed a bug where cleave wasn't working with 1HB weapons.
Kerran Beastlords should now be using the proper summoned Tiger model.
Guild Masters in the New Sebilisian Expedition should now train all of the appropriate skills.
The Froglok Monk Guildmaster in the Rathe Mountains will now properly train Monk skills such as Feign Death and Mend.
The orc appentice in Crushbone has finished his training, and become a fullblown apprentice!
Some misbehaving quest NPCs in Kerra Isle can no longer be inadvertently lured into combat
It is now possible to read a specific "note" type item used in a Kerra Isle quest by right-clicking on it.
Upper Guk will no longer have placeholders for named creatures, such as the froglok gaz squire and the froglok shin lord.
The Ishva Mal will no longer proc Harm Touch.
The Gloomwater Arrow will now drop one at a time in Kedge.
Damage spells that have a stun component should now properly apply the stun (subject to stun immunities from recent stuns)
The Shaman spells Tortoises Healing, and Slugs Healing, have had their prices adjusted to be in the correct order.
Necromancer NPCs and pets should no longer cast Dark Empathy, Shadow Compact, Corporeal Empathy, or Pact of Shadow.
Corrected an issue where the weekly timer was incorrectly set for the Void-Touched Potential weekly task.
Affected players who were unable to get their Void-Touched Potential yw will now be able to obtain it.
The server will once again reset at 8:00 AM PDT on Tuesdays.
You can now look up your transaction history in Account Management.
We have addressed an issue that was resulting in disconnects when multiple players in the same household were playing together. You should be able to play together now without disconnecting.
We have identified an issue that was causing unintended resource usage on the backend. We've deployed a fix but it will take some time to take effect.
Combined with the peak population coming down, the lag should dissipate shortly.
Mistmoore Castle has received a major upgrade!

In addition to named NPCs being guaranteed spawns, they now all have a guaranteed loot drop of a common or rare item with stat bonuses. While some of these items are familiar to explorers of the castle in years past, many are brand new. Some include exciting new effects ready for you to enjoy as they are or turn into exaltations.
All named enemies in the zone have now also been designated as rare creatures, vastly increasing their chances of dropping motes of potential.

Additionally, the residents of the main castle are now somewhat less aggressive and will not react to your presence from extreme ranges... during the daytime. Exploring the castle at night, however, will still be a harrowing affair once the castle denizens have shown their true forms.
The UI Scaling system now supports fractional ui scaling in .25 increments, ranging from 0.75x to 4.00x.
The Cursor now has its own scaling factor in the in-game Options (O).
A toggle now exists in the in-game Options (O) to use the Operating System cursor, rather than the in-game cursor.
Grouping will now give a small experience bonus as intended.
Increased the melee combat potential of Beastlord Warders substantially.
Fixed an issue where raid invites would fail in certain circumstances.
Non attackable NPCs can no longer multiclass.
Address an issue where NPC corpses could continue walking even after they have died.
Restored the original, Classic two-handed blunt animations to the game.
You will no longer gain skillups from skills you haven't used when riposting.
Creatures in the Plane of Fear and beyond should no longer fear or charm you so hard that you're unable to approach the game again for 24 hours.
Fix for players getting charmed, and then shrunk by the pet scaling option ingame.
Addressed an issue where NPCs would continue attacking each other after charm fades.
Fixed a bug where cleave wasn't working with 1HB weapons.
Updated the messages that appear while being stunned to clarify that you are now immune and that you are currently immune on subsequent hits.
Fix an issue where zone specific music tracks would skip over music tracks if environmental sounds were disabled.

Fix an issue where music would need to completely come to a stop before being able to resume the same track. The same track will now be able to resume the same sequence without having to fully have the track come to a stop.
Targeted area effect lull spells, such as Harmony, can now take effect on NPCs you have not engaged in combat.
Mounts that are obtained from AAs will now only grant the Mount speed when you are a valid class for using that AA.
Fixed an issue where a long (5-10 sec) recovery cooldown would fire if you used the Stop Action keybind with a Bard as one of your classes.
Fixed an issue where range checks on contact procs like Vampiric Embrace would not work properly on NPCs with large hit boxes.
The Lifespike spell has been moved from level 8 to level 5 for Shadowknights.

A new lifetap spell, Lifebite, has been added at level 10 for Shadowknights, and level 8 for Necromancers. This new spell has been added to the autogrant list for both classes, and to the appropriate spell vendors.
The Wasps/Bees of Plane of Sky have seen had their stingers filed down while charmed.
The Wasp/Bee in Plane of Sky known as 'Murderbee' should be a bit easier to exterminate in solo instances.
Shimmering Meteors have also had their damage tuned downwards while charmed.
Snow no longer overwrites the zone's precipitation type, preventing rain from falling. Praise Karana.
Rain is no longer too small to see.
Many wild animals should now be friendly towards Kerran, similar to how they react to Rangers & Druids.
Monsters should no longer try to patrol through walls in Runnyeye.
Seplawishinl Bladeblight in the Ocean of Tears now has a considerably shorter respawn timer.
Fixed an issue where high level named monsters in Kedge Keep were taking an excessively long time to respawn.
Non-raid boss NPCs are now restricted from casting charm if they already have a pet.
The Soldier's Brooch quest in Rathe Mountains will now allow the player to choose their reward.
Updated the Torrid Corruptor final turn in to properly grant the quest completion title to some players that do not meet the 'lore' requirements of the quest.
Players are now given the corresponding Potential of the Void task when they enter a raid instance.
Upon entering a raid instance, all other Potential of the Void tasks are removed from the task list.
Corrected an issue that allowed Player Illusions to be used as Pet Illusions.
As a result of this change, we have added a Conversion button to Guise of the Deceiver and Amulet of Necropotence that allows these items to be turned into a Pet Illusion version.
Bloodmoon now has the Focus Effect Improved Vampirism III.
Fixed an issue preventing Armor Ornamentation Tokens from working created from Cloth armor.
Copper Band now has +1 AC.
The Unholy Steed, Holy Steed, Abyssal Steed, and Valiant Steed AAs will now summon bridles, which can be used to summon the mount, instead of directly summoning the mount.
[ADDENDUM] The Bridles can be placed in inventory or Activated Items storage. After that, they can be hot keyed.
Fix an issue where various item animations (such as whips and bows) were not animating on attack.
Player pets are now prevented from equipping secondary-only items when they utilize a two-hander in their primary hand.
The search feature for spell inside the actions window has had its data expanded to be able to search many more fields.
Added UI Scaling to the server selection screen.
Fix an observed issue with spacing and scaling.
Fix an observed issue where windows would not keep relative position and not keep on screen when resizing or rescaling.
Adjusted inventory AC and weight labels to not include erroneous spacing.
Scaling now applies before character select so that loading screen also scales properly.
Fixed a Layout calculation bug that was causing the Actions window to produce graphical artifacts when shrinking the window vertically.
On fresh installations of EverQuest Legends, a value for UI Scaling is now automatically detected and used.
Changed UI Font Scaling to use dynamic re-rasterization.
The map window should now be more compatible with UI Scaling.
All context menus will now be fully kept on screen. This includes the spell list when you right click an empty gem.
The Personal Instance window now properly shows respawning/non-respawning selections correctly.
Fixed a display issue with the item inspection window that occurs after viewing an item that is convertible, such as the Gnoll Slayer item.
A batch of new maps have arrived for the Maps window.
Fixed a bug causing the Control Option 'momentary duck toggle' to not load its saved state.
Added a new Options toggle in Interface->general to use the Actions/Spells window instead of the spellbook for the "Open Spellbook" keybind, and the Book Button on your spell bar.
Bloodmoon now has the Focus Effect Improved Vampirism III. In some cases, your existing Bloodmoon may not gain this effect. If this affects you, you may loot a new Bloodmoon to merge yours into.
Added new items to most rare creatures within the zone.
Improved some existing items within the zone.
Undead monsters commonly seen on the first floor of the estate interior now occasionally drop Fine Steel weaponry.
Rare monsters are now guaranteed to spawn with no placeholders.
Several additional monsters recognizable as named are now flagged as rare creatures, and will benefit from increased mote drop rates.
Rare creatures in Solusek's Eye are now guaranteed spawns with no placeholders.
Several additional monsters recognizable as named are now flagged as rare creatures, and will benefit from increased mote drop rates.
Decreased the amount of hitpoints that raid bosses have in multiplayer play within raid (voidling) zones.
Fixed an issue where receiving an instance charge reset the timer to 1 hour when it should have been a remainder.
Pets will no longer have their own faction and will no longer have their own aggro range.
Killing Pickclaw Goblins will now raise faction with Priests of Mischief.
NPC pets should no longer be capable of summoning a pet.
Increased the runspeed of the Bristly Boar Reins by one speed tier.
Players who have acquired the Torrid Corruptor can now retroactively grant themselves the quest title by right-clicking the item while it is equipped. Title may require zoning before it propagates.
Increased the AC value of armor drops from Warlord Skarlon.
Added endurance to the Verishe Mal Greataxe.
Corrected tint on the Dark Mail items from Najena.
Fixed an issue where Full Potential would not be granted in some cases.
Added a new Beastlord AA Ability: Strike As One.
Pets can now gain benefits from pet proc spell upgrades (damage, resists).
Fixed an issue where summoning a familiar was interfering with pets properly re-leveling to their upgraded state after zoning.
Fixed F1 (Target myself) targeting to always select the pet if both a pet and familiar are present.
Added preview of updated spell effects when motes are added to the merge slot in the spell display window.
Fixed a bug that can cause erratic spell cooldowns for instant-cast spells.
Fixed a bug where the instance menu could become unresponsive when editing keybinds.
Right clicking on the spell gem in the actions window will now operate the same as right clicking else where in the list. Added an upgrade hint to the description section.
Added the next charge time to the instance menu.
Prevented tooltips from going off-screen while using window scaling.
Fixed map centering when using scaling options.
Fixed UI window scaling issues in modern UI where "keep on screen" settings were not being properly applied on full UI reload.
Fixed UI reloading when not using "keep my settings."
Fixed quantity drawing on the tradeskill window.
Increased the maximum draw range of nameplate scaling in Options.
Removed nameplate fonts from UI scaling to maintain readability.
Resolved an issue with fonts that was contributing to issues with line breaks occuring too soon.
Added modern input fields to the Social Hotkeys edit window (cut, copy, paste, cursor movement without shift, etc).
Added 2 new nameplate options for aggro indicators:
The 50-slot bank box will be added to the in-game marketplace with this patch.
