Deity specific spells can now be scribed without having the proper deity, however you cannot cast or memorize that spell unless you are actively the correct deity.
Potion/Philter of the Bone Field should no longer be craftable.
Dropdown menus will now properly close when the parent window is closed.
A Constructed Potential should now show up on Find in zones they inhabit.
Looms should now show up in the Find Window like the other in world tradeskill containers.
Hodstock Hills and Plane of Knowledge should no longer show up in the Find Window in Nektulos Forest.
Fixed a client visual desync for unusable items caused by exaltations with deity requirements.
Key Ring has been renamed to [Alternate] Storage.
Expeditions have been renamed to Instances.
Blood Siphon and Blood Draw Venoms should once again heal for the DoT damage they deal.
Fixed an issue with loot lockouts in groups that could cause them to award only one item on the initial lockout.
Blood Draw Venom now correctly has its direct damage component.
Spiritual Light now correctly shows Endurance in its description.
War Cry ranks 2 and 3 have been hidden.
The Personal Instance window will now update current instance properly after quitting an instance.
Barbarian Berserkers will no longer get a message on creation about Tomes.
Constructed Potential should now show up on Find.
The Voidling has disappeared from East Freeport.
Azaracks and Essence Carriers in the Plane of Sky have been staked down to their island, and should go wandering less often
The quest efreeti in Plane of Sky should no longer assist any other NPCs that may find their way into their room.
Noble Dojorn has one less blade storm guardian in solo instances.
Damage numbers in Solo Plane of Sky have been adjusted to be a bit less oppressive.
a presence has been gated from spawning in Personal Plane of Sky instances.
Inte Akera has been properly tuned for solo instances of Plane of Sky.
Gorgons/Harpies in Plane of Sky should no longer proc a mez in Solo instances.
Strandar Pinemist now asks for the correct number of items.
Hekzin G`Zule should now respond to rogues he's less friendly with.
Dason Goldblade can now properly summon Inte Akera in solo instances of Plane of Sky.
Slightly lowered the assist ranges of Spirocs in open world/group Plane of Sky.
Cazic-Thule now properly calls for his minions when he is engaged in an instance of the Plane of Fear.
Killing Dread, Fright, Terror, and/or a Dracoliche will decrease the range that Cazic-Thules call for aid can be heard.
Reduced the social aggro range of many enemies in Najena.
Bloodstained Key in Najena is no longer NO RENT/Temporary
Flaming Fist is no longer NO TRADE
Skeletal Rod is no longer NO STORAGE
Dark Mail Gauntlets renamed to Dark Mail Mittens (no longer conflicts with Dark Mail Gaunlets from Lower Guk)
Silver Stud now has +1 AC.
The following items are no longer incorrectly flagged as quest items:
Automatically shows new/all learned invocations and stances.
Hide any stance or invocation by right clicking on the button and clicking hide.
Unhide any stance or invocation by right clicking and looking in the "hidden" submenu.
Stance Button Highlight - The overlay color of the button when the stance is active.
Stance Button Lasso - The outline color of all stance buttons.
Invocation Button Highlight - The overlay color of the button when the invocation is active.
Invocation Button Lasso - The outline color of all invocation buttons.
Each invocation and stance is bindable.
Stance bar toggle is also bindable here.
Players can now upgrade spells using motes. Upgrading spells can be done through inspecting spells (via right-click hold) and adding motes, similar to upgrading items with motes.
Upgraded spells currently gain the following benefits, with more added later.:
Reduced mana cost.
Reduced cast, recovery and re-use time.
Increased durations.
Increased potential for the spells to not be resisted.
Fixed observed crashing related to a dead Moth.
The Stunning Poison Rogue ability has been adjusted down to level 14.
The Concussive Poison Rogue ability has seen an increase in it's chance to proc.
Rogues have a new poison available to them, starting at level 18.
Starting at level 23 Rogues will begin gaining access to the following combination utility poisons, that provide the benefits of two of their existing utility poisons, in one buff.
Reduced Forage cooldown to 60 Seconds.
Essence Carriers in the Solo instance of Plane of Sky should no longer spawn on island 1.
Wind Runes should now drop in Solo instances of Plane of Sky.
Adjusted placement of enemies on Island 3 (Gorgalosk) in Solo instances of Plane of Sky.
Mobs in instances of Plane of Sky should no longer flee.
Necklace of Resolution now has a reuse time of 5 minutes.
Lizard Tails now drop from the lizardmen in the Temple of Cazic Thule.
Clurg, the wonderous bartender of Oggok, has a new task.
Fixed pets equipping a shield with a 2H weapon and remove visible weapons when unequipped.
NPCs will no longer proc mez/fear/charm style innates on solo players.
Adjusted social aggro ranges in Najena.
Fixed Drelzna's drop rates.
Moosh in Najena is now guaranteed to drop his key.
Reduced the usable level of the following Enchanter spells:
A new line of healing spells has been added for the Druid class.
Shamans have access to four new spells. These are meant to be alternatives to Rancor and Stoicism.
The Shaman spell Rancor has been renamed to Impassivity.
Beastlord pets are now, themselves, also Beastlords in addition to Warriors, instead of Berserkers and Warriors.
Reduced the mana cost of the Cleric's Duration Heal spells (Celestial Remedy, Celestial Health, and Celestial Healing)
Promised Renewal now has a 1 second cast time, an increased mana cost, and heals for 5000.
Pure melees can now toggle off Unyielding Invocation.
Pure casters can now toggle off Channeler's Stance.
The ability to produce the following items has been removed.
Fixed an issue where you could get negative charges by having a group member invite you to their instance while you have 0 charges.
Fixed an issue where after loading a loadout, keyrings in the storage tab would not update until you click different tabs inside the storage tab.
Fix black screen flicker when entering game from character select.
Spell upgrades will not reflect on items that have a spell proc that is also an upgraded spell. These will default to the base spell.
Added spell upgrade information to inspected spell windows.
Fix spell gem swapping and suppress already memorized messages.
Exaltations in the Augmentation Storage will now be correctly labeled as Exaltations.
Added toggle in group windows context menu to allow for it to expand upwards instead of downward.
Fix floating combat text filtering for misses/dodge/block/etc.

A loom and forge have been set up in the New Sebilisian Expedition. A couple of merchants have scrounged some supplies and are selling them near the loom and forge. In addition, some of the spell vendors in the New Sebilisian Expedition have taken up residence in the next room down the hall, as an extra defense against whatever is behind the barricade.
The Stance Bar now has new icons available for all texture variants.
Fixed an issue preventing default positions from being picked up.
Adjusted the default window position of the stance bar.
Addressed an issue affecting the ability to create instances.
The Planes and the Hole should now be accessible on every server.
Removed errant charge check for DZ invites to multiplayer raid instance.
When you leave a personal instance you will now be placed at zone safe coords.
Leaving an instance will now put you in the base zone. (Difficulty 0)
A personal instance charge is now only consumed upon successful entry to the zone.
Fixed replay timers occurring on adding a group member to a personal instance zone.
Players can now enter instances of the zone they are in, regardless of difficulty or pickzone.
Summon Pet/Warder spells will now add the rank of the spell to the summoned pet's level, capped at player level -1.
Each upgraded pet level will increase hp by 6%, add 1 base damage, and add 5 skill points.
Enabled pet inventory for charmed NPC pets.
Charmed pets now equip from the pet inventory slots and those items are removed when charm breaks.
Charmed pets now report their inventory of player given equipped items.
Spell upgrades now have damage and healing bonuses.
Spellblade, Quickbuff and Symphonic Aura now trigger upgraded spells/songs.
Spell upgrade duration effects now work for lull effects.
Added rounding to spell upgrade duration calculations to help scaling of small values. (2 or 3 ticks)
Max level of crowd control effects (mez, charm) increased by spell tier.
10% chance per spell tier to not consume reagents for spells that require reagents. Reagent costs are skipped at tier 10.
Summon item spells will now summon item's tier to the spell tier if the item is upgradable.
Combat Innate Buffs with procs are cast at one half of the buff's spell tier level.
Added the following Class AAs:
Locked doors in Najena will now search bags for keys instead of requiring the key to be held on the cursor.
Drelzna will no longer rapidly proc Harm Touch.
Zombies in Misty Thicket should now appear slightly more zombie-like.
Tradeskill vendors in the New Sebilisian Expedition are now on the proper faction.
While in Plane of Sky you can now summon normal non-scaled pets.
Doing quests for Da Bashers of Grobb will now also increase your standing with the Grobb Merchants.
Buff effects on players and pets with upgraded levels now persist across camping and zoning.
Removed low level item haste cap. Standard haste cap rules still apply.
The various Wind Runes from the Plane of Sky can now be held in Currency Storage.
The Golden Crescent Key used in the Najena dungeon is no longer Temporary/NO RENT
Improved taunt success rates, most notably while fighting raid mobs.
Cleave and Bash are no longer on shared timers.
Blood Draw Venom should now correctly do more damage than Blood Siphon Venom.
Paralytic Poison now correctly triggers the Weakening Strike, instead of Hobbling Strike.
The following spells can now only be casted on group members, your pet, or your self.
Stoicism and Slugs Healing have both had their heal per tick increased from 160 to 200.
The final heal of the Druid's "Bloom" spells is now affected by AAs.
Druid "Bloom" heals now have a more appropriate visual effect when they Bloom.
Blooming Heal description now accurately reports that its Bloom heals for 300, not 200.
Rain spells will no longer hit npc's not on the aggro list.
Beastlord Warders will now have mana, allowing them to actually cast their spells.
Significantly increased the melee capabilities of Beastlord Warders.
Regeneration modifiers from stances and invocations always apply even if they are not active while out of combat as long as you have access to the stance/invocation.
Empowering and overchannel invocations now work on damage over time and heal over time spells.
Empowering effects and costs were reduced to balance out spell upgrade bonuses.
Reverted Arcane Mastery to prior values.
Display summoned pet stats on inventory window pet tab.
Improved Colors of Login Server Text
Fixed a missing flag preventing heal crits from showing up in logs.
Fixed an issue where client showed incorrect max level for some toggleable AAs.
Difficulty button menu will now function properly after right clicking on the difficulty button.
Opacity and spell filtering now work for spell particles.
Added a toggle to filter beneficial bard songs to make symphonic auras less bulky.
Fixed clients display of alternate ability caps.
Stance/Invocation bar visibility should now save properly.
Fixed which default INI file the UI should use based on resolution of the game window.
The message for shielding now goes to the skills filter.
Options window context menu's will now function properly such as alpha.
Stance/Invocation ability hot buttons and buttons in actions window now use matching icons from stance bar.
Actions Window stances/invocation highlight boxes will no longer be rendered when not on abilities tab. Gate ritual now shows your bind location rather than your origin.
Buff effects now indicate the upgrade level of the cast spell (spell names, tooltips, display info window).
Updated various displayed spell names in ui and chat to use the upgraded spell name (appends suffix).
Spell display window now shows resistance debuff benefits for detrimental spells.
Added the upgraded spell title to the 'begin casting' chat messages.
Fixed intermittent "must select target to cast spell" for item clicky effects & rituals.
sectionNames: All instances should now work properly!
Pre-Launch Beta Natch Potes, July 7, 2026 (2 of 2)

sections.name: AAs
items: Quick Buff can no longer be used in combat.
Lay On Hands and Harm Touch AAs will no longer show ranks 11 and 12, which were unobtainable.
The Abyssal, Holy, Unholy, and Valiant Steed AAs now directly summon a horse, instead of creating a bridle.
Valiant/Abyssal Steed is actually fixed this time.

sections.name: Achievements
items: Fixed missing connection in the Race Unlock - Erudite achievement for High Council of Erudin.
Plane of Hate Explorer Achievement should now trigger from Plane of Hate, instead of Plane of Hate B.

sections.name: Abilities
items: Add Paladin Smite and Shadowknight Reave abilities.
Added Skill Caps for Smite (Paladin) and Reave (Shadow Knight). Starting at level 9, they gain 5 points per level.

sections.name: Difficulty
items: Multiclass mobs can no longer cast unobtainable player spells.
Reduced multiclass mob health scaling in solo instances by 66%
Reduced casting speed of difficulty-scaled raid mobs slightly.
Fixed mob difficulty haste scaling not working correctly.
Removed difficulty-scaling of aggro range from solo instances.
Reduced difficulty-scaling of aggro range everywhere else.
Reduced resist penetration of difficulty-scaled raid mobs in solo instances.
Reduced difficulty-scaled mob health by 33%
Reduced multiclass mob health scaling everywhere else by 50%
Reduced difficulty-scaling damage by 33%

sections.name: Gameplay
items: Monk animations now exist for Trolls, Ogres, Dwarves, Gnomes, and Halflings. Kickin'!
Bard animations now exist for Trolls, Ogres, Dwarves, Gnomes, Halflings, and Iksars. Sing your heart out!

The Translocators at the docks, provided by the Academy of Arcane Sciences, have grown tired of standing around all day for no pay, and have started charging 1 platinum piece per level, to send you on your way.
A new translocator route has been added between Freeport and Qeynos.
Fixed reciprocal attack range when you are levitated.
Motes now drop in a 10 level range instead of 5.
Fixed an issue causing Learned Recipes to disappear after zoning.
Frederic Calermin will now ask if you wish to "test your skills", instead of powers.
Paineel NPCs will no longer give more than 100 faction per hit.
Due to population increases, open world difficulty 0 zones will now spawn additional picks.
Resurrections during combat is now allowed. All other same-zone respawns are blocked while in combat.
Ranged and throwing attacks no longer consume ammo.
Fixed an issue with reloading pet equipment if a pet item is merge upgraded.
NPC pets will now despawn if the owner is killed.
Voidlings can now see you if you're invisible.

sections.name: Instances
items: Plane of Hate and Plane of Fear raids are now available!
Group raids for all currently available raid content are now available (including Hate and Fear)!

Raid instance Loot Lockouts removed from all non-raid-target mobs. In raid instances, loot should now drop from kills of all mobs that don't trigger a mob-specific lockout timer shown in the Expedition window.
Personal Instance lockout timers have been reduced to 1 hour from 3 hours.
Fixed an issue that was blocking looting from solo kills of mobs with loot lockouts in dynamic instances.
Solo raid instances should now properly apply lockouts for replay and individual NPC lockout timers.

sections.name: Invocations
items: Fix beastlords not being considered wisdom casters.
Updated Invocation Descriptions:

sections.name: Items
items: Fiery Avenger's Two-Handed Bash worn effect has been replaced with Virtuous Bash, increasing Bash minimum damage by 15 and reducing Bash cooldown by 1 second.
Removed the Magic Resist from Pristine Studded Leather Tunic.

sections.name: Loadouts
items: Resolved a client stuck state when attempting to save the current loadout in a non-swap zone.
Resolved some situations where Items or Exaltations could disappear during Bandolier or Loadout swaps.
Resolved an issue with Loadout Equipment swapping caused by invalid exaltations prior to their removal.
Bandolier swapping will now verify that an item is still valid for the destination slot.

sections.name: NPCs
items: Dramatically reduced the assist radius of Gynok Moltor in Befallen.
Dark Assassin in Feerrott should now give XP.

sections.name: Spells
items: Change per-spell resist hardcaps to resist softcaps.
Added Endurance Regeneration to Chloroplast.
Descriptions updated for the following spells, as they are no longer limited to outdoors:

sections.name: UI
items: Added a new slider under nameplate tab in options to scale the size of nameplates.
Feign Death -- Toggle option under general to enable/disable standing when pressing the skill again while already feigning also made the camera pan when using right click while feign death.
Ward of the Divine buff icon is now fixed.
Lull spells tooltip durations have been fixed.
Ineligible disciplines from other loadouts no longer appear in the actions window.
Fixed issues with raid window filtering.
Fixed an issue with storage tab on inventory updating.
Added CTRL and SHIFT key modifiers for clicking items in your storage to pickup 1 or a stack of the item.
Removed TAB stops from hidden buttons on server select screen.
Tutorial text updated for clarity around Primary race changing.
Fix spelling/grammar errors in ability descriptions.

sections.name: World
items: Added a banker to Plane of Sky, next to the fire.

sections.name: Hotfix Notes - May 29th, 2026
items: Fixed an issue where under certain scenarios you could lose an item(s) while trading if you crash/lose internet/lose power/game and/or PC abruptly closes.
The Raid instance version of Maestro of Rancor has had his lifetap proc rate greatly reduced.
Open world Maestro of Rancor has had his lifetap proc reduced.
Fixed an issue where personal instances were still not 1 hour. This should be corrected.
You can once again request a raid instance of The Hole.
Re-added 2Handed Bash to Fiery Avenger.
The Lay On Hands and Harm Touch cooldown bonuses from smite and reave now only trigger on successful hits.
Allow the use of Smite and Reave while mounted.
Sky Teleport Pads from Quest Room and Island 8 now work.
Fix overly optimistic client side melee range code that was allowing autoskills to trigger a cooldown but were blocked by the server.
Smite (Paladin Ability) mana cost reduced to 2%, damage increased to 3.5x.
Block invocation changes while casting and improve client / server invocation and stance cooldown synchronization.
Multiplayer Raid for Nagafen zone in location is no longer inside a wall.
The group instance for Nagafen's Lair can now contain more than one player.
Obsidian Shard should no longer drop from the bees in Plane of Sky.
Torc of Veeshan should no longer drop from Noble Dojorn in Plane of Sky.

sections.name: Hotfix - May 31st, 2026
items: Lay on Hands has been updated to function with implied targeting and related systems.
Dragoon Zytl will now give experience when killed.
Fix a crash on zone servers.
Fix an issue where, as a charmed player, you would be suicided as an NPC clone when the caster of the charm dies.
Paineel Armor and Weapon merchants should once again sell adventuring gear, instead of spells!
Reduced difficulty scaling of mob haste.
Amplification (Bard Song) no longer amplifies itself.
Amplification has been buffed slightly.
Fixed an issue where loot lockouts in dynamic zones were not using the proper type of dynamic timer.
Fix an issue where players would not be counted as actual players for personal loot purposes when charmed, feared or linkdead.

sections.name: General
items: Addressed several crash and stability issues.
Fixed /gems to use the reordered draw.
Speculative fix for keys sticking with ALT-TAB
Zones that had a difficulty threshold of 10 now have a threshold of 12.
Increased difficulty instance spindown time.
Fix an issue where on zoning you'd pick zones that are of higher difficulty, if not in a group, or when grouped and your group wasn't already in a zone greater than difficulty 0.
Addressed an issue where zones would constantly spin up and spin down at less than 10 players in a single difficulty at minimum.
Fixed a crash that would occur while you have charm memorized as a bard, you become charmed, and then your character attempts to land a charm on an NPC.

sections.name: AAs
items: Berserker Blood Rune AA will no longer trigger on normal spell critical hits.

sections.name: Achievements
items: Newly created Humans should now properly unlock the achievement for their starting city, instead of always unlocking Freeport.

sections.name: Audio
items: Fixed an observed crash on autofire related to starting and stopping the combat music.
Attempted an additional fix issue with midi audio handles.

sections.name: Gameplay
items: Pets/Charmed players will no longer cast charm spells.
NPC's will no longer mesmerize your entire group.
Large Bowl Sketches are now for sale on some pottery merchants.
The isle goblin chieftain has returned to the island in Ocean of Tears.
Wind Runes from Sky should no longer mention Classes in their lore.
Fixed an issue preventing fast regen from working for characters with less than 180 hp/mana/endurance.
Removed enemy resist bonus from enemies that are yellow considered.

sections.name: Instances
items: Balance changes to Solo Raid versions of Innoruuk, Cazic-Thule, Maestro of Rancor, and Lord of Loathing.
Enemies in the Planar raids will now path back to their spawn points when they get bored.

sections.name: Loadouts
items: Reverted a change that was preventing weapons from being equipped during loadout swaps in certain situations.

sections.name: Skills & Stances
items: Fixed an observed crash on checking skillups when charmed after a failed dual wield, double attack or triple attack.
Berserker stance will no longer receive the attack speed boost and ranged stance will no longer receive the double and triple attack bonus when endurance drops below 2% remaining.

sections.name: Spells
items: Pets will now have unique classes.
Magician Earth Pets will now be Rangers.
Necromancer and Shadow Knight pets will now be Shadow Knights.
Enchanter Animation pets will now be Paladins.
Beastlord Warders will now be Berserkers.
Summoned player pets now always add Warrior class if they are not already a Warrior.
Multi-class player pets get doubled health.
Additionally, the Magician Fire pet has more mana and better mana regen now.
Iksar's Skeleton Illusion spells will now instead turn them into an Iksar skeleton. The head is consistent with their gender.

sections.name: UI
items: Fixed inconsistent spell cast timers used for UI displays between your target and self.
Fix the /doability helper tips for stances and invocations in the actions window descriptions.
Changed /doability for invocations and stances so they no longer toggle off (back to recover or balance) if activated when already active.
Added additional default Textures variants (Alternative 1, 2, 3) to the game.
"Texture" was renamed to "Spell Gem Textures" on the options menu to be more concise.

sections.name: General
items: Improvements to server memory optimization.
Added Client Update for Partial Dispel (Duration Reduction)
Added the Audio Triggers button back to the EQ button.
Improved the pet weapon equipping logic.

primary only weapon will be blocked from equipping if there is an already equipped weapon in the primary slot with a better score, but a better primary / secondary will be equipped in the secondary slot if the primary-only weapon is equipped first.
1H weapon given to a dual wield capable pet that already has a 2H weapon equipped will always replace the 2H weapon to allow dual wielding.
2H weapon given to a pet that already has a 1H weapon equipped will replace the 1H only if it has a stronger score and the secondary slot is empty.

sections.name: AA
items: The Burst of Power AA is now not purchasable until level 46.

sections.name: Achievements
items: Slayer Achievements should once again be able to award Banestrike.

sections.name: Gameplay
items: Charmed NPCs will no longer unsummon themselves if the owner dies.
Changed the out of combat timer to 9 seconds from 12 seconds, to give some leeway on ticks.
Avatar Power, Lava Breath, Frost Breath, Beholder Dispel, and Phobocancel now only reduce the duration of the effected buff, instead of removing it entirely.
Planar armor from the planes of Hate and Fear has been shuffled around!
Characters should no longer consume Azarack Blood and Azarack Skin.
Styria Fearnon in Ocean of Tears will now properly continue her dialogue as you converse with her.
Implied targeting will now use the determined target from start of cast if that target is available at end of cast time.

sections.name: Instances & Picks / Difficulties
items: Players should no longer sometimes be accosted by giants upon zoning into Naggy raid instances.
Zoning into alternate difficulties of Kedge Keep no longer points you towards the exit.

sections.name: Loadouts
items: Resolved an issue where Augmentations may not save correctly in a Loadout Swap.

sections.name: Spells
items: Lifetap spells will no longer double-dip on the heal component through criticals, focus effects, healing AAs, or the Empower Invocation.
Gnome Beastlords should notice their warders have had more legs bolted on!
Gnome Beastlord Warders have changed from Clockwork Rats to Clockward Spiders.
Beastlord Warders should now properly reflect your base race, instead of your illusioned race.
The Combat Innate self buffs from Paladin, Shadow Knight, and Ranger should now all stack. Those same spells should also stack with Boon of the Garou.
Iksar skeleton pets are now anatomically correct.
The Wizard spell Thunderclap now has an AoE range of 30.

sections.name: Stances & Invocations
items: Added Arcane Mastery Invocation
Added Channelers Stance
Added Unyielding Invocation

sections.name: UI
items: Add accessibility tab to options and included a new pet size slider which will control all summoned pet sizes.
Added checkboxes under combat text for loot and sell.
Spell damage filtering will now work properly when you have bard in your loadout and use the bard song filter.
Invalid loot items that no longer exist on the corpse are properly removed from the loot window when a loot request fails.
Fixed error message wording for zooming in and out while in find mode on the map.
Fixed an issue where your spell bar columns/rows weren't loaded properly making your spellbar change shape and size on each relog/UI reload.
Fixed an issue with loading screen tips where several tips were merged together.

sections.name: Dungeon Revamp!
items: Blackburrow has been revamped!

sections.name: General
items: More crash fixes and memory optimizations.

sections.name: Gameplay
items: Fixed aggro and social ranges in Blackburrow.
Shaman spirit wolves are now Beastlords in addition to being Warriors. They should also correctly use the original wolf models.
Reave, Cleave, Smite, Stances, and Invocations are now all usable while mounting.
Cazic Thule will now remember targets from further away.
NPCs in Befallen that drop keys for the doors in the zone can no longer be charmed.
Monks rejoice! Gnoll pups in Qeynos Hills & Qeynos newbie yard can once again be killed for scalping.

sections.name: Items
items: Sharp Claws now have the combat effect "Laceration".
Corrected the stats on the Keg Mallet.
Reduced the AC values on the Lustrous Russet set of armor.
Blood-Drawn Runes is now Lore Equipped.
The planar armor sets, with the exception of the wrist slots, are now Lore Equipped.

Adding missing armor graphics to Raw-Hide Arm Guard, Vagrant's Tunic, Ill-Fitting Slippers, Ill-Fitting Robes, Dark Runed Leggings, Wicked Sallet, Pub Pants, Hardened Bark Breastplate, and Well Worn Boots.
Added missing stats to Ill-Fitting Robes.
Newly added standard NPCs in Blackburrow now have their loot tables.

sections.name: Loadouts
items: Players can now swap loadouts in the Arena.

sections.name: Spells
items: Paladin, Shadow Knight, and Ranger combat innates should now properly stack with Rogue poisons.
Buffs should no longer become permanent from having their duration be taken under 0 seconds due to dispel.

Lifetaps should now properly heal the amount it taps for. Lifetap damage will continue to receive bonuses from Improved Damage, Soul Abrasion and Empower. The Heal component will always match the damage dealt.

sections.name: UI
items: Fixed personal instance toggle and state, the other personal instance elements now enable/disable as intended.
Plane of Hate should now show up in the Zone Guide.

sections.name: General
items: Fixed an issue where some server requirement flags were failing on the server dependent on specific expansions being open.

sections.name: AAs
items: The Unbound Nature AAs for Druids should now properly allow for Crits from direct damage, instant heal, heal over time, and damage over time spells.

sections.name: Instances
items: Enabled Personal Instances of Nagafen's Lair, Permafrost, The Hole, and Kedge Keep.
Phinigel Autropos, Lord Nagafen, Lady Vox, and Master Yael will no longer spawn in open world and personal instances.

sections.name: Spells
items: Permanent buffs should no longer be dispelled by duration reducing effects.
Shallow Breath should now appear under 'Utility Detrimental -> Disempowering'

sections.name: UI
items: Fixed Rogue Poison descriptions.
Fixed an issue where the Tradeskill Depot had the wrong Item Cap applied for Closed Beta.

sections.name: General
items: Plane of Sky island trash will no longer drop key quest parts.
Each boss in Plane of Sky now drops the keys to the next island (two keys in the case of the Thunder Spirit Princess)
Sirran will no longer spawn when the boss of an island in Plane of Sky is killed.
Keeper of Souls is now a static spawn.
Sister of the Spire is now a static spawn.
The Spiroc Guardian and The Spiroc Lord are no longer static spawns. Killing Spirocs on the island will spawn the Guardian, and killing the Guardian will spawn the Lord.
All Plane of Sky quests are now completable at their respective Efreeti, instead of having to spawn additional NPCs.

sections.name: AAs
items: Added the Warriors Endurance AA, a new class AA for Warriors.
Added the Unbound Wrath AA, a new autogranted class AA for Warriors.
Added the Unbound Strikethrough AA, a new autogranted class AA for Rangers.
Added the Playing Possum AA, a new class AA for Beastlords. Allows the player to feign death.
Added the Shroud of Stealth AA to Rogues, available at level 35.
The Persistent Casting AA is now only 6 ranks, with a cost of 1/2/3/4/5/6, for 11% chance to regain concentration and complete a spell cast when stunned, per rank.
The Bard AA Reaching Notes has been expanded to the first 6 ranks (3 active, 3 inactive). The cost has also been adjusted from 3/6/9 to 2/4/6.
Escape, the Rogue AA, is now effective against NPCs up to 20 levels higher than the rogue.

sections.name: Achievements
items: Updated the Description of the 'Hide Your Brains!` achievement.
Cleaned up a number of unobtainable Slayer achievements, and adjusted others to fit in era for accomplishing.

The Class Unlock achievements now trigger from the quest completion, instead of owning the items. This will force a re-evaluation of the achievements, but players shouldn't lose access to any classes.
Banestrike should be getting rewarded for Slayer Achievements again, for real this time.

sections.name: Audio
items: Added in correction to reset pitch bends occurring when playing new tracks.
Restored functionality that mute/unmutes character creation music instrument tracks, dependent on race you've selected, after the initial fanfare.
Restored music to Plane of Sky.
Added music to the tutorial zone!

sections.name: Gameplay
items: Crusader Iktra in the Northern Desert of Ro has some requests.
Fixed an issue where implied targeting would ignore your pet making you not able to cast spells on it during combat.

Reduced the assist radius of most of the enemies in Blackburrow. This does not mean nothing will notice you from a bit further away. A couple of sharp-eyed gnolls are on the lookout, and you should use caution when engaging enemies in wide-open areas.
Lich of Miragul will now spawn upon the zone starting up.
The respawn times at the Ogre monument in West Karana have been normalized a bit.
Lord Grimrot and Ghanex Drah in South Karana is now a bit more likely to spawn.
High Shaman Phido and High Shaman Grisok should now spawn in South Karana.

All locked doors in Befallen now share behavior: they can find their keys in your bags, and you can click lockpicks on them to attempt to pick the lock if you have rogue or bard and the appropriate skill level.

sections.name: Instances
items: Raid Loot lockouts should no longer trigger improperly, for example, in The Ruins of Old Paineel (The Hole)
Maestro of Rancor, Innoruuk, the Prince of Hate, Cazic Thule, Fright, Terror, Dread, and a dracoliche no longer spawn in the open world & personal instances of Planes of Hate and Fear.
Multiplayer instance raid bosses have been buffed.
Personal instances for Plane of Hate and Plane of Fear are now available!
Entering a personal instance of or changing difficulty in Runnyeye or Solusek's Eye will now face you into the zone, rather than out towards the exit.

sections.name: Items
items: Reduced the effectiveness of item tier increases for weapon damage.
Adjusted stats on the Runed Sabertooth Girdle.
Berserker has been removed from Keg Mallet.
The Smoked Glass Key is no longer Temporary.
Many jewelry "trash" drops (e.g. Copper Amulet, Silver Ring) now have 1 AC making them slightly more useful

sections.name: Stances & Invocations
items: Fixed a bug causing Overchannel to increase mana costs.
Halved the endurance costs of Overchannel, Inversion and Spellblade.
Slightly reduced effectiveness of Empower for healing.
Greatly increased effectiveness of Empower for damage.
Improved Arcane Mastery all around.
Fixed an erroneous calculation in Berserker Stance conditionally affecting damage.

sections.name: Skills & Spells
items: All classes should now have access to the Strategy skill.
Feign Death will now break songs, including melodies. Symphonic Aura pauses on unconscious and resumes on standing. Songs are prevented while in the Feign Death state.
Research skill has been removed. You may still see it in your skills window, but you'll no longer be able to increase its skill.
Pack Chloroplast will now increase Endurance regeneration.
Ethereal Cleansing will now only lock out spells for 1.5 seconds, instead of 5.

sections.name: UI
items: Vision of Sebilite now shows up when 'Show only items I can use' is selected, for Enchanters.
Pet size slider shouldn't effect random things anymore.
Equipment from Befallen that goes into visible equipment slots but was missing Ornamentation sockets now has those sockets.
The spell Illusion: Scaled Wolf is now listed under Utility Beneficial -> Illusion: Other
Removed Spell: Imbue Fire Opal and Spell: Mass Imbue Fire Opal from the Wizard Spells merchant master list.
Adjusted the description of Spell: Feign Death to emphasize that you need to stand. "Causes you to stop breathing and appear dead to most creatures, until you stand up."
Fix buff sorting issue with ward of the divine proc and other similar buffs.

sections.name: Hotfix - June 18th, 2026
items: More memory optimizations.
The previous patch that increased raid target health pools has been reverted.
Warriors Endurance AA is temporarily disabled.
Unbound Wrath is now working. Critical Damage modifications are now working again.
The Beastlord Class Unlock achievement will now properly use the quest check.

Swapped the opening character music to another version that supports initial 'fanfare' swapping on the first intro fade. Instrument track muting should no longer persist past character creation / selection. The character select section of the game will now play race-specific music as character creation does.
Crusader Iktra now properly stops taking Metal Bits at Amiable.
Translocator Gnomes now no longer charge for characters who've never passed level 20.

sections.name: Hotfix - June 21st, 2026
items: More memory optimizations. This also fixes an issue with AA requirements, such as Harm Touch being out-of-era.
You will no longer find Priests of Discord hanging about the cities. In their place is a construct of pure potential!

sections.name: General
items: Zone Experience Modifier Changes
Removed all Continent and Primary Class channels from autojoin.

sections.name: World & Dungeons
items: Najena has received a touch-up!
The hastily built barricades in New Sebilis have started to rattle...

sections.name: AAs
items: The Warrior's Endurance AA has been re-enabled.
The Escape AA for Rogues has been fixed to not be autogranted.

sections.name: Disciplines
items: Rogues now gain two new disciplines at level 46.

sections.name: Gameplay
items: A mysterious presence has been spotted lingering near one of the voidlings. Brave adventurers should probably investigate.
Voidlings can now see through nearly every from of invisiblity and stealth.
The Arena has been reverted to it's original form.
A Constructed Potential now exists in Surefall Glade & New Sebilis Expedition.
Updated Dialogue for Sulgar in Everfrost Peaks.
Innoruuk should now do less damage in melee than Cazic Thule, per round.

sections.name: Instances
items: Personal instance charges are now implemented.
charge is consumed when you enter personal instances.
Raids now have a bonus loot lockout system where if you are in that lockout you will only receive 1 piece of loot per named raid creature that has its own lockout.
Fixed an issue where raid recreation could put you in the wrong difficulty.
The difficulty button has been revamped to be more intuitive.
Personal instances of the Plane of Sky are now operational.
Removed 2 enemies from the Lady Vox room in Permafrost Solo Raid instances.

sections.name: Items
items: Golden Pendant now has +1 AC.
Rain Caller's Firestrike effect now has unlimited charges, with a 2 minute recast time.
Kedge Backbone should no longer drop from Phinegal Autropos.
The change to weapon upgrade scaling has been reverted back to before the nerf bat swung.

sections.name: Loadouts
items: Players can no longer swap loadouts while hiding or sneaking.
Players can no longer swap loadouts while trading or using a world container. (Forge, Loom, etc.)

sections.name: Spells
items: The Beastlord spell "Spiritual Light" now also provides endurance regeneration.
The Beastlord spell "Sha's Lethargy" is now a 40% slow, increased from 30%.
Beastlords now have access to the spell Languid Pace, starting at level 35.
The Ranger spell Force of Nature is now a permanent self-only buff.
Call of Earth, the previous level 50 spell for Rangers, has been pushed down to level 48.
Adjusted debuff stats on Suffocating Sphere so that Shallow Breath won't overwrite it.
Deity specific spells can now be scribed without having the proper deity, however you cannot cast or memorize that spell unless you are actively the correct deity.

sections.name: Tradeskill
items: Potion/Philter of the Bone Field should no longer be craftable.

sections.name: UI
items: Dropdown menus will now properly close when the parent window is closed.
A Constructed Potential should now show up on Find in zones they inhabit.
Looms should now show up in the Find Window like the other in world tradeskill containers.
Hodstock Hills and Plane of Knowledge should no longer show up in the Find Window in Nektulos Forest.
Fixed a client visual desync for unusable items caused by exaltations with deity requirements.
Key Ring has been renamed to [Alternate] Storage.
Expeditions have been renamed to Instances.

sections.name: General
items: Blood Siphon and Blood Draw Venoms should once again heal for the DoT damage they deal.
Fixed an issue with loot lockouts in groups that could cause them to award only one item on the initial lockout.

sections.name: Spells, Abilities and AAs
items: Blood Draw Venom now correctly has its direct damage component.
Spiritual Light now correctly shows Endurance in its description.
War Cry ranks 2 and 3 have been hidden.

sections.name: UI
items: The Personal Instance window will now update current instance properly after quitting an instance.
Barbarian Berserkers will no longer get a message on creation about Tomes.

sections.name: Zone Population
items: Constructed Potential should now show up on Find.
The Voidling has disappeared from East Freeport.
Azaracks and Essence Carriers in the Plane of Sky have been staked down to their island, and should go wandering less often
The quest efreeti in Plane of Sky should no longer assist any other NPCs that may find their way into their room.
Noble Dojorn has one less blade storm guardian in solo instances.
Damage numbers in Solo Plane of Sky have been adjusted to be a bit less oppressive.
a presence has been gated from spawning in Personal Plane of Sky instances.
Inte Akera has been properly tuned for solo instances of Plane of Sky.
Gorgons/Harpies in Plane of Sky should no longer proc a mez in Solo instances.
Strandar Pinemist now asks for the correct number of items.
Hekzin G`Zule should now respond to rogues he's less friendly with.
Dason Goldblade can now properly summon Inte Akera in solo instances of Plane of Sky.
Slightly lowered the assist ranges of Spirocs in open world/group Plane of Sky.
Cazic-Thule now properly calls for his minions when he is engaged in an instance of the Plane of Fear.
Killing Dread, Fright, Terror, and/or a Dracoliche will decrease the range that Cazic-Thules call for aid can be heard.
Reduced the social aggro range of many enemies in Najena.

sections.name: Items
items: Bloodstained Key in Najena is no longer NO RENT/Temporary
Flaming Fist is no longer NO TRADE
Skeletal Rod is no longer NO STORAGE
Dark Mail Gauntlets renamed to Dark Mail Mittens (no longer conflicts with Dark Mail Gaunlets from Lower Guk)
Silver Stud now has +1 AC.
The following items are no longer incorrectly flagged as quest items:

sections.name: New Stance/Invocation window
items: Automatically shows new/all learned invocations and stances.
Hide any stance or invocation by right clicking on the button and clicking hide.
Unhide any stance or invocation by right clicking and looking in the "hidden" submenu.

sections.name: Stance/Invocation Window Coloring
items: Stance Button Highlight - The overlay color of the button when the stance is active.
Stance Button Lasso - The outline color of all stance buttons.
Invocation Button Highlight - The overlay color of the button when the invocation is active.
Invocation Button Lasso - The outline color of all invocation buttons.

sections.name: Stance/Invocation Keybinding
items: Each invocation and stance is bindable.
Stance bar toggle is also bindable here.

sections.name: Spell Upgrade System Implementation
items: Players can now upgrade spells using motes. Upgrading spells can be done through inspecting spells (via right-click hold) and adding motes, similar to upgrading items with motes.
Upgraded spells currently gain the following benefits, with more added later.:
Reduced mana cost.
Reduced cast, recovery and re-use time.
Increased durations.
Increased potential for the spells to not be resisted.

sections.name: General
items: Fixed observed crashing related to a dead Moth.

sections.name: Disciplines & Skills
items: The Stunning Poison Rogue ability has been adjusted down to level 14.
The Concussive Poison Rogue ability has seen an increase in it's chance to proc.
Rogues have a new poison available to them, starting at level 18.
Starting at level 23 Rogues will begin gaining access to the following combination utility poisons, that provide the benefits of two of their existing utility poisons, in one buff.
Reduced Forage cooldown to 60 Seconds.

sections.name: Instances
items: Essence Carriers in the Solo instance of Plane of Sky should no longer spawn on island 1.
Wind Runes should now drop in Solo instances of Plane of Sky.
Adjusted placement of enemies on Island 3 (Gorgalosk) in Solo instances of Plane of Sky.
Mobs in instances of Plane of Sky should no longer flee.

sections.name: Items
items: Necklace of Resolution now has a reuse time of 5 minutes.

sections.name: Gameplay
items: Lizard Tails now drop from the lizardmen in the Temple of Cazic Thule.
Clurg, the wonderous bartender of Oggok, has a new task.
Fixed pets equipping a shield with a 2H weapon and remove visible weapons when unequipped.
NPCs will no longer proc mez/fear/charm style innates on solo players.
Adjusted social aggro ranges in Najena.
Fixed Drelzna's drop rates.
Moosh in Najena is now guaranteed to drop his key.

sections.name: Spells
items: Reduced the usable level of the following Enchanter spells:
A new line of healing spells has been added for the Druid class.
Shamans have access to four new spells. These are meant to be alternatives to Rancor and Stoicism.
The Shaman spell Rancor has been renamed to Impassivity.
Beastlord pets are now, themselves, also Beastlords in addition to Warriors, instead of Berserkers and Warriors.
Reduced the mana cost of the Cleric's Duration Heal spells (Celestial Remedy, Celestial Health, and Celestial Healing)
Promised Renewal now has a 1 second cast time, an increased mana cost, and heals for 5000.

sections.name: Stances & Invocations
items: Pure melees can now toggle off Unyielding Invocation.
Pure casters can now toggle off Channeler's Stance.

sections.name: Tradeskills
items: The ability to produce the following items has been removed.

sections.name: UI
items: Fixed an issue where you could get negative charges by having a group member invite you to their instance while you have 0 charges.
Fixed an issue where after loading a loadout, keyrings in the storage tab would not update until you click different tabs inside the storage tab.
Fix black screen flicker when entering game from character select.
Spell upgrades will not reflect on items that have a spell proc that is also an upgraded spell. These will default to the base spell.
Added spell upgrade information to inspected spell windows.
Fix spell gem swapping and suppress already memorized messages.
Exaltations in the Augmentation Storage will now be correctly labeled as Exaltations.
Added toggle in group windows context menu to allow for it to expand upwards instead of downward.
Fix floating combat text filtering for misses/dodge/block/etc.

sections.name: World
items: A loom and forge have been set up in the New Sebilisian Expedition. A couple of merchants have scrounged some supplies and are selling them near the loom and forge. In addition, some of the spell vendors in the New Sebilisian Expedition have taken up residence in the next room down the hall, as an extra defense against whatever is behind the barricade.

sections.name: General
items: The Stance Bar now has new icons available for all texture variants.
Fixed an issue preventing default positions from being picked up.
Adjusted the default window position of the stance bar.

sections.name: Hotfix July 1, 2026
items: Addressed an issue affecting the ability to create instances.

sections.name: Update from Rogean 07/03/26:
items: The Planes and the Hole should now be accessible on every server.

sections.name: All instances should now work properly!
items: Removed errant charge check for DZ invites to multiplayer raid instance.
When you leave a personal instance you will now be placed at zone safe coords.
Leaving an instance will now put you in the base zone. (Difficulty 0)
A personal instance charge is now only consumed upon successful entry to the zone.
Fixed replay timers occurring on adding a group member to a personal instance zone.
Players can now enter instances of the zone they are in, regardless of difficulty or pickzone.

sections.name: General
items: Summon Pet/Warder spells will now add the rank of the spell to the summoned pet's level, capped at player level -1.
Each upgraded pet level will increase hp by 6%, add 1 base damage, and add 5 skill points.
Enabled pet inventory for charmed NPC pets.
Charmed pets now equip from the pet inventory slots and those items are removed when charm breaks.
Charmed pets now report their inventory of player given equipped items.

sections.name: Spell Upgrades
items: Spell upgrades now have damage and healing bonuses.
Spellblade, Quickbuff and Symphonic Aura now trigger upgraded spells/songs.
Spell upgrade duration effects now work for lull effects.
Added rounding to spell upgrade duration calculations to help scaling of small values. (2 or 3 ticks)
Max level of crowd control effects (mez, charm) increased by spell tier.
10% chance per spell tier to not consume reagents for spells that require reagents. Reagent costs are skipped at tier 10.
Summon item spells will now summon item's tier to the spell tier if the item is upgradable.
Combat Innate Buffs with procs are cast at one half of the buff's spell tier level.
Added the following Class AAs:

sections.name: Gameplay
items: Locked doors in Najena will now search bags for keys instead of requiring the key to be held on the cursor.
Drelzna will no longer rapidly proc Harm Touch.
Zombies in Misty Thicket should now appear slightly more zombie-like.
Tradeskill vendors in the New Sebilisian Expedition are now on the proper faction.
While in Plane of Sky you can now summon normal non-scaled pets.
Doing quests for Da Bashers of Grobb will now also increase your standing with the Grobb Merchants.
Buff effects on players and pets with upgraded levels now persist across camping and zoning.

sections.name: Pre-Launch Beta Natch Potes, July 7, 2026 (2 of 2)
Items
items: Removed low level item haste cap. Standard haste cap rules still apply.
The various Wind Runes from the Plane of Sky can now be held in Currency Storage.
The Golden Crescent Key used in the Najena dungeon is no longer Temporary/NO RENT

sections.name: Skills & Disciplines
items: Improved taunt success rates, most notably while fighting raid mobs.
Cleave and Bash are no longer on shared timers.
Blood Draw Venom should now correctly do more damage than Blood Siphon Venom.
Paralytic Poison now correctly triggers the Weakening Strike, instead of Hobbling Strike.

sections.name: Spells
items: The following spells can now only be casted on group members, your pet, or your self.
Stoicism and Slugs Healing have both had their heal per tick increased from 160 to 200.
The final heal of the Druid's "Bloom" spells is now affected by AAs.
Druid "Bloom" heals now have a more appropriate visual effect when they Bloom.
Blooming Heal description now accurately reports that its Bloom heals for 300, not 200.
Rain spells will no longer hit npc's not on the aggro list.
Beastlord Warders will now have mana, allowing them to actually cast their spells.
Significantly increased the melee capabilities of Beastlord Warders.

sections.name: Stances & Invocations
items: Regeneration modifiers from stances and invocations always apply even if they are not active while out of combat as long as you have access to the stance/invocation.
Empowering and overchannel invocations now work on damage over time and heal over time spells.
Empowering effects and costs were reduced to balance out spell upgrade bonuses.
Reverted Arcane Mastery to prior values.

sections.name: UI
items: Display summoned pet stats on inventory window pet tab.
Improved Colors of Login Server Text
Fixed a missing flag preventing heal crits from showing up in logs.
Fixed an issue where client showed incorrect max level for some toggleable AAs.
Difficulty button menu will now function properly after right clicking on the difficulty button.
Opacity and spell filtering now work for spell particles.
Added a toggle to filter beneficial bard songs to make symphonic auras less bulky.
Fixed clients display of alternate ability caps.
Stance/Invocation bar visibility should now save properly.
Fixed which default INI file the UI should use based on resolution of the game window.
The message for shielding now goes to the skills filter.
Options window context menu's will now function properly such as alpha.
Stance/Invocation ability hot buttons and buttons in actions window now use matching icons from stance bar.
Actions Window stances/invocation highlight boxes will no longer be rendered when not on abilities tab. Gate ritual now shows your bind location rather than your origin.
Buff effects now indicate the upgrade level of the cast spell (spell names, tooltips, display info window).
Updated various displayed spell names in ui and chat to use the upgraded spell name (appends suffix).
Spell display window now shows resistance debuff benefits for detrimental spells.
Added the upgraded spell title to the 'begin casting' chat messages.
Fixed intermittent "must select target to cast spell" for item clicky effects & rituals.
